newsitem.title: USA: Jefferies Group names Klowden Pres., COO.
newsitem.headline: Jefferies Group names Klowden Pres., COO.

text.p: Jefferies Group Inc said on Monday it has named Vice Chairman Michael L Klowden president and chief operating officer of Jefferies Group and its principal operating subsidiary, Jefferies & Co Inc.

"Mike has been a key participant in our strategy to move Jefferies to a position of leadership as an integrated middle-market investment banking firm," Frank Baxter, chairman, said in a statement. "His new title formalizes the operating responsibility that he assumed this year."
Klowden, 51, joined Jefferies in April 1995 as vice chairman of the board of Jefferies Group.
A Jefferies official said Klowden assumes the title of President from Baxter, who remains chairman and chief executive officer. The chief operating officer position is a new role at the company.
